tagline: Over the high bridge and down the island to the ferry.
intro: From Fidalgo Island the highway crosses Deception Pass about 180 feet above the water and runs south the length of Whidbey Island to Coupeville on Penn Cove. Below Coupeville it becomes SR 525 and goes inland through Greenbank, turns along Holmes Harbor at Freeland and comes down to the ferry landing at Clinton.

Before the bridge there was a ferry with no timetable. Travelers called it by banging a saw with a mallet, then sat back to wait. The bridge was dedicated in 1935, and at the other end the Mukilteo boat takes about 20 minutes.
season: State of Washington Tourism says the route is open by road and ferry year-round, with summer the busiest and spring and fall often quieter.

moments.title: Deception Pass
moments.text: Two spans meet on Pass Island, an arch over Canoe Pass and a longer crossing over Deception Pass itself, where the current can run at nine knots underneath.

moments.title: Coupeville
moments.text: Captain Thomas Coupe laid out the town on Penn Cove in the 1850s, and he was the only man ever to sail a full-rigged ship through Deception Pass.

moments.title: Greenbank
moments.text: SR 525 cuts straight through Greenbank, named for a homestead back in Delaware and home to Greenbank Farm and its big 1904 barn, once given over to loganberries.

sources.label: State of Washington Tourism, Whidbey Scenic Isle Way
